title: SEO/AEO standings snapshot record
description: One append-only JSONL record per (run, surface). Keyed by (run_date_bucket, deploy_sha, surface) for idempotent reconciliation (SEO-AEO-LOOP.md §3).

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the record was written

run_date_bucket.description: UTC date bucket; the monitor dedupe key

deploy_sha.description: short git SHA of the site at read time

payload.description: surface-specific data (per-page verdicts, counts, rates, CIs)
